title: Pop-Tarts® Crazy Good Rewards — scan your grocery receipt, earn points, redeem for rewards
offer_text: Pop-Tarts® Crazy Good Rewards — Earn Points, Get Rewards. "Scan your grocery receipt after buying participating Pop-Tarts® products to earn and redeem points for rewards — the more you scan, the more you save!" "Sign up to be the first to know about new flavors, drops, swag and get personalized content and exclusive coupons!"
expiry_basis: Standing program; the issuer publishes no end date.
requirements: Free account at poptarts.com (email and date of birth requested at sign-up)
Buy participating Pop-Tarts® products in a physical store
Upload the grocery receipt through the program to earn points; rewards are redeemed through the account

bay_area.note: Shopping happens at any Bay Area grocery store that stocks Pop-Tarts; the receipt scan and redemption are done on Kellanova's official site. No store list is required by the program.

The rewards landing page offers only 'I'm New' / 'I already joined' entry points to an anonymous visitor; no public terms PDF was linked from the page.
